title: Petcube Video Event Bark Count Leaderboard
dataSources: Pet tracker location/activity (`tractive:position`, `whistle:activity`), smart feeder events (`petfeeder:event`), litter-box usage (`litterrobot:cycle`), bird-feeder cam detections, plant/soil sensors (`plant:sensor`).
app: Pet GPS/activity trackers (Tractive/Fi/Whistle), smart feeders and litter boxes, bird feeders/cams, and plant sensors via vendor APIs and MQTT to HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=petcube:video bark_count=*
| stats sum(bark_count) as total_value, avg(bark_count) as avg_value by camera_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks camera values by total and average bark count across Petcube video event events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `bark_count` values for each Petcube video event event and review total and average bark count by camera.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total bark count.
grandmaExplanation: It times which camera shows the biggest bark count numbers in your Petcube video event data.
